en.title: Automatically approve PRs for coding agents
en.summary: More developers are using coding agents to write code, run checks, and open PRs. As more development teams move toward the "software factory" model, approvals are becoming the next bottleneck. Routine fixes and dependency updates across multiple repositories can leave engineers facing a growing queue of PRs awaiting approval.

items_all.title: 元子：被AI助手环绕——注意力是一切的圆心
items_all.summary: 元子在搭建了18个AI助手后，却被源源不断的消息与待办裹挟，后来幡然醒悟：AI可以近乎零成本完成执行，却替代不了人的在场成本，注意力才是人机协作的核心。还给出了可直接复用的注意力保护方案：任务分层归档、沉淀个人偏好准则、严格控制每日高专注时长。

en.title: Yuanzi: Surrounded by AI assistants — attention is at the center of everything
en.summary: After building 18 AI assistants, Yuanzi found himself overwhelmed by a constant flood of messages and to-dos — until it hit him: AI can handle execution at near-zero cost, but it can't replace the human cost of being present. Attention is the core of human-AI collaboration. He also shared a directly reusable attention-protection playbook: tiered task archiving, distilled personal preference guidelines, and strict daily limits on high-focus hours.
